subject.label: sport
subject._note: School of Sport container context: a single academic school spanning sport & exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, and strength & conditioning. There is no QAA sport benchmark in this repo, so the prose is grounded in sport & exercise science and wider sport domain knowledge rather than a benchmark document.

_note: School of Sport container context pack for starting-progressing-succeeding-advanced (Succeeding tier). Worked examples draw on a different sport-school subject per lesson: L01 sport & exercise science, L02 sport coaching and physical education, L03 sport therapy and rehabilitation.
